UpdateSourceArgs: bash -c 'set -eu; P="https://bannerlordcoop-nightly-gateway.garrett-luskey.workers.dev/install-linux.sh"; M="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bannerlord-Coop-Team/BannerlordCoop-website/main/installer/install-linux.sh"; F="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/BannerlordCoop-Nightly-Installer-$$.sh"; export BANNERLORDCOOP_INSTALLER_LAUNCHER=1; for r in curl bash tr; do command -v "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Required command not found: $r"; exit 1; }; done; download() { rm -f "$F" "$F.lf"; curl -fsSL --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 --retry 2 --retry-delay 1 -o "$F" "$1" || return 1; tr -d "\r" < "$F" > "$F.lf"; mv "$F.lf" "$F"; [ -s "$F" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$F")" -ge 4096 ] && [ "$(head -n 1 "$F")" = "#!/usr/bin/env bash" ] && [ "$(sed -n "2p" "$F")" = "# Official Bannerlord Coop nightly installer for Linux." ]; }; echo "Downloading the latest BannerlordCoop nightly installer..."; if ! download "$P"; then echo "Nightly gateway failed; trying GitHub mirror..."; download "$M" || { rm -f "$F"; echo "Could not download the latest installer."; exit 1; }; fi; set +e; bash "$F"; R=$?; set -e; rm -f "$F"; exit "$R"'
